title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Invites Guests to Make the Most of Summer with 25% Off Summer Season Passes
summary: Beginning August 3, passholders will also receive a free lemonade or dirty soda with every visit through September 1 Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world's premier owner-operators of location-based entertainment, today announced a new Summer Season Pass offer. Beginning August 3 through September 1, guests can purchase Summer Season Passes for 25% off, while all passholders will receive one complimentary lemonade or dirty soda with every visit. As families look to make the most of the final weeks of summer, Lucky Strike Entertainment continues to invest in affordable experiences that encourage repeat visits and time together. The enhanced Summer Season Pass offer delivers even greater value, giving guests more reasons to return throughout the season. The Summer Season Pass includes two games of bowling and shoe rental every day at participating Lucky Strike, AMF and Bowlero locations, while Premium Pass holders also receive daily arcade reloads, discounts on food
